note: Agent-proposed bounded WP4C envelope (slice 3 of WP4); see docs/workstreams/wp4c-assignability-v1alpha4.md. Engine only; call sites land in WP6/WP7.

fixtures.title: Numeric and same-type assignability
assertions: number is not assignable to integer.
string is not assignable to integer.

fixtures.title: enum/const value containment
fixtures.input: Source enum subset, non-subset enum, matching and mismatching const.
assertions: All Source enum/const values must be accepted by Target.
Non-subset enum and mismatching const are rejected.

fixtures.title: Nullability rule
fixtures.input: Nullable Source bound to non-nullable Target.
assertions: The engine returns NULLABILITY_MISMATCH for the caller to map to INPUT_NULLABILITY_MISMATCH.
No implicit non-null narrowing is assumed.

fixtures.title: Object required/extra/closed-key rules
fixtures.input: Target required missing from Source, extra Source key against closed Target, valid matching object, optional Target property.
assertions: Target required keys must be guaranteed by Source required keys.
Extra Source keys are rejected by a closed Target.
Nested property assignment is recursive and conservative.

fixtures.title: String/number/array bound implication
fixtures.input: Tighter and looser length/range/array bounds and item types.
assertions: Source bounds must imply Target bounds.
Looser bounds and incompatible item types are rejected.

fixtures.title: Unresolved $ref is never guessed
fixtures.input: Source or Target root containing $ref, or a Schema without the G.4 dialect.
assertions: Schemas without the exact G.4 dialect are never used for assignability.
The caller must resolve references and re-run.
